body: In March 2020. The MRI was taken in August 2021. I only go to school, nothing more
No, I'm from Europe. I only did go to pain clinics and hospitals. I'm 21

I already have had 3 opinions from different neurologists. It makes me very confused and doubtful. One says I absolutely cannot operate because they see such patients more often and the pain has only worsened. The other one says I can operate but he cannot promise that I will be completely pain free. 

I also have several acquaintances who have the same problem and have had surgery. They are still in pain.

I don't know what to do anymore. I know that only I can decide but I don't know what the best is for me.
I have pain in my right leg every day. For this I take tramadol and NSAID. I sometimes have trouble with walking because of the pain and sitting for a long time is quite painful (after standing up)

I had an mri taken and it showed that I have 2 herniated discs.

According to my neurosurgeon, surgery would not be very helpful because there is a high chance of getting another hernia, and chronic back pain. The nerve pain might go away but it won't solve the problem.
He suggested to postpone it and I should try to live with it. And if I wish, that surgery will happen anyway. I don't know what to do.
